description: List ChangeGamer editorial guides (always free, separate from the licensable corpus): compact rows (slug, title, cluster, kind, order, description, updated, Markdown URL), one page at a time, plus the cluster list. `cluster` narrows to one topic; `full: true` returns the complete index with search intents, takeaways and variant URLs. No body content — fetch bodies with get_article. Size with full: true: about 740 KB.

full.description: true = the complete /api/articles.json index; other arguments ignored.

name: list_articles
title: List guides
